srList.sentence: scRNA-seq library construction and data preprocessing The Cell Ranger software pipeline (version 3.1.0) provided by 10x Genomics was used to demultiplex cellular barcodes, map reads to the genome and transcriptome using the STAR aligner, and down-sample reads as required to generate normalized aggregate data across samples, producing a matrix of gene counts versus cells.
